hooks.name: plc-temporal-safety-gate
hooks.description: Deterministic shell safety gate running the RelayGhost temporal model checker whenever a PLC XML benchmark is saved

hooks.name: ears-interlock-advisor
hooks.description: Autonomously synthesizes Rolls-Royce EARS safety interlocks when a PLC invariant failure is reported

action.prompt: A PLC file at {{filePath}} was saved. Use the relayghost-verifier MCP tool to verify temporal invariants. If any safety invariant fails, analyze the counterexample cycle, explain the physical hazard in plain English, and synthesize a Rolls-Royce EARS interlock patch to resolve the defect.
